name: Vijay Janapa Reddi

affiliations.role: Co-founder, Vice President and board member; Research co-chair
Professor of engineering and applied sciences

bio: Vijay Janapa Reddi is a professor of engineering and applied sciences at Harvard and a co-founder and Vice President of MLCommons, where Reddi sits on the board and oversees MLCommons Research. Reddi co-led development of the MLPerf benchmarks and co-chaired MLPerf Inference.
